content.jointProblem: Can a combined script-normalization, phoneme-canonicalization and morphology-aware indexing pipeline, integrated with Elasticsearch and updatable without full re-index, reduce LinguaBot's measured 18% Serbian support-query miss rate to below 5% on its labelled bank-query data while meeting latency and maintenance constraints?

rationale.text: The researcher's group directly works on mixed-script Serbian information retrieval, script normalization, transliteration, and inversion indexes robust to script variation.

sources.quote: Njegova istraživačka grupa bavi se pronalaženjem informacija u dokumentima koji sadrže mešovito ćirilično-latinično srpsko pismo, normalizacijom skripte, transliteracijom kao korakom u pretprocesiranju i izgradnjom invertovanih indeksa otpornih na varijacije pisma.

rationale.text: He has studied how stemming and lemmatisation interact with script normalization during search-index construction.

sources.quote: ispitujemo kako stemovanje i lematizacija interaguju s postupkom normalizacije skripte pri izgradnji pretražnog indeksa

rationale.text: He has evaluated phoneme-based token canonicalization for Serbian script unification and shown reduced out-of-vocabulary rates on a legal gold standard.

sources.quote: The phoneme-based canonical form reduced the out-of-vocabulary rate from 9.3% to 2.1% compared with a Latin-only baseline

rationale.text: He has worked on real-time mixed-script retrieval and incremental index updating under low latency.

sources.quote: Sistemi za pretragu u realnom vremenu nad tokovima vesti zahtevaju inkrementalno ažuriranje indeksa s niskim kašnjenjem.

rationale.text: His project experience includes an open-source script-normalization module compatible with popular search frameworks and pilot deployments.

sources.quote: razvijen je open-source modul za normalizaciju pisma kompatibilan s popularnim okvirima za pretragu

rationale.text: He has prior contract research adapting a search module for Serbian court decisions with a Novi Sad legaltech startup.

sources.quote: sarađivao je s jednim novosadskim startapom iz oblasti legaltech-a na prilagođavanju pretražnog modula za srpske sudske odluke

rationale.text: He is open to contract research on internal search engine customization.

sources.quote: contract research on internal search engine customization

constraints.text: The pilot must define, measure, and reduce the bank-query miss rate from the current 18% to below 5%, with a maintenance process that keeps it there.

sources.quote: A good outcome is getting that 18% miss rate below 5% and keeping it there with a manageable maintenance process.

constraints.text: The work must be testable within six months and fit a modest tooling/data budget of around 8,000 EUR.

sources.quote: Budget for tooling or data work is modest — around 8,000 EUR — and we want something testable within six months.

constraints.text: Evaluation should use LinguaBot's labelled query-response data and in-house linguist annotation/validation.

sources.quote: We have a labelled query-response dataset of around 85,000 pairs across all clients, and our two in-house linguists can annotate or validate proposed solutions.

constraints.text: The approach must tolerate mid-sentence Latin/Cyrillic script mixing and integrate with LinguaBot's existing Elasticsearch/spaCy-based stack.

sources.quote: users freely switch between Latin and Cyrillic script mid-sentence
spaCy with custom Serbian morphological components

constraints.text: The indexing/lemmatisation approach must support updates when new vocabulary arrives without requiring a full re-index.

sources.quote: can be updated when new vocabulary arrives without a full re-index

constraints.text: Researcher capacity is limited to one smaller industrial contract or consultancy alongside two active projects; exact availability remains unknown.

sources.quote: Trenutno je angažovan na dva aktivna projekta, ali ima kapaciteta za jedan manji industrijski ugovor ili konsultantski angažman.

risks: The strongest evidence is from news, legal, web, and benchmark corpora, not from bank customer-support chat queries; the first experiment must explicitly test transfer to LinguaBot's 12,000-query sample and 85,000 labelled pairs.
Even fine-tuned multilingual models underperform on inputs that mix scripts within a single sentence, so script mixing may remain a residual error source.
Manual synonym resources do not scale: the researcher's own pilot work reports that modules need updating when new terminology appears and the initial synonym dictionary is incomplete.
The 8,000 EUR budget and six-month horizon may only support a focused pilot, not full production hardening across all clients and products.
Researcher availability is not confirmed; the notes state capacity for one smaller contract only, alongside two active projects.
questions: Can Stefan Dragić confirm his availability and the exact scope of one smaller industrial contract or consultancy for the six-month pilot?
Which LinguaBot product and Elasticsearch index should be targeted, and what are the current latency, throughput, and deployment constraints?
Can LinguaBot provide the 12,000-query bank sample, the 85,000 labelled pairs, relevant query logs, and linguist validation time within the 8,000 EUR budget?
How exactly is 'no useful result' defined and measured for the 18% baseline, and which query set will define the below-5% target?
Who owns and updates the normalization, lemma, and exception resources after the project, and how often does new product terminology arrive?
Does LinguaBot prefer a joint project or an industrial PhD format, and is there any co-funding or in-kind engineering time beyond the stated budget?
